summary: Edgemode, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a leakout agreement with lenders holding ~$1.65M in convertible promissory notes. The agreement limits each lender to converting, assigning, or transferring no more than 30% of owed balance over 30 days (15% if stock closes below $0.003). It replaces a prior standstill and expires Dec 31, 2026. This is a routine debt covenant adjustment—not a special situation. No terms, premium, or strategic initiative are involved; the filing is purely operational and creditor-related.
